Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── 1b. AS-OF PRICE AND VAT RATE PER INVOICE LINE. This is what fixes the zero-PDV report. RUCIznos and PDVIznos on the kalkulacija line record what was true when the goods were priced IN, not when they were sold. Goods kalkulisane before VAT registration carry PDVIznos = 0 forever, so every later sale of them reported no tax — the ZERO_PDV warning below was firing on that, and blaming KMP__SyncPDV for it. CijeneStavki answers the question that was actually being asked: what price and rate were in force for this batch ON THE INVOICE DATE. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── The join returns EVERY event up to the invoice date, so a line appears once per event. Ordered by line then by the event sort key, the LAST row for a line is its as-of state — FileMaker SQL has no window function to express that, so the walk below keeps overwriting and the final write wins. ──

Value.Calculation: "SELECT il.\"PrimaryKey\", cs.\"Cijena\", cs.\"PDVPostotak\" " & "FROM \"Invoices\" i, \"InvoiceLines\" il, \"CijeneStavki\" cs " & "WHERE il.\"ForeignKeyInvoiceID\" = i.\"PrimaryKey\" " & "AND cs.\"ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID\" = il.\"ForeignKeyStavkaUlazneFakture\" " & "AND cs.\"VaziOd\" <= i.\"Datum\" " & "AND i.\"ForeignKeyCompanyID\" = ? " & "AND i.\"Datum\" >= ? AND i.\"Datum\" <= ? " & "AND i.\"DeletedAt\" IS NULL AND il.\"DeletedAt\" IS NULL " & "AND ( i.\"StatusDokumenta\" = 'Račun' OR i.\"StatusDokumenta\" = 'Reklamacija' ) " & "ORDER BY il.\"PrimaryKey\", cs.\"VaziOd\", cs.\"TipPrioritet\", cs.\"IzvorBroj\""
